watch.summary: A streamer rants about annoying flashbangs making players want to quit and become accountants, right before the player on screen gets immediately blinded.

beats.what: Streamer starts ranting about flashes making people question why they play video games.
Streamer jokes they should work as accountants instead, right as a flash completely blinds the player.
The player gets flashed again immediately after the streamer finished talking about it.
Streamer puts his hand on his head in complete disbelief at the perfect comedic timing.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I should work as an accountant instead!
watch.why: The creator's rant about flashbangs lines up perfectly with the exact moment the pro player gets repeatedly blinded on screen. His genuine reaction of hands-on-head disbelief sells the sudden coincidence.
